cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
죽음의 폐광 퀘스트
천천히 읽으면서 가요!
뉴비끼리 재밌겠다~
cuts.visual_prompt: Three-quarter medium-wide comic panel in agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean webtoon style on a pure solid #FFFFFF white background. On the left, 오크 전사 beams excitedly while holding an open parchment quest scroll with both hands, her one-handed sword and kite shield neatly strapped to her back. On the right, 타우렌 드루이드 peeks happily around a small wooden mining cart beside a minimal patch of dusty cavern floor.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
글 읽을 시간 없어!
대포로 철문 따고 바로
밴클리프 잡으러 갑시다!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic low-angle comic action panel in agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean webtoon style on a pure solid #FFFFFF white background. On the left foreground, 언데드 성기사 smugly leans beside a black iron pirate cannon with her golden paladin shield strapped on her back, firing a loud comic blast toward the right that shatters a heavy iron-bound dungeon gate into flying splinters. On the far right background, 오크 전사 drops her scroll in shock with tiny sweat drops.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
저기요, 나가주세요!
분위기 좀 즐기려는데
왜 혼자 다 밀고 난리예요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder angled confrontation panel in agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean webtoon style on a pure solid #FFFFFF white background. On the left, 오크 전사 leans forward with furrowed brows and angry anime vein marks, pointing firmly toward the dungeon exit with an empty hand while her one-handed sword and shield stay sheathed on her back. On the right, 언데드 성기사 stands slightly turned away in side-back view with crossed arms and an unbothered expression.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
오리 40인 공대장인데
전사 말고 성기사나 법사 해!
만렙 찍어야 재밌지!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic low-angle side-three-quarter panel in agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean webtoon style on a pure solid #FFFFFF white background. On the right, 언데드 성기사 stands tall lecturing pompously with one hand on her hip and the other pointing a lecturing index finger upward, her golden paladin shield on her back. On the left, 오크 전사 slouches heavily with slumped shoulders and an exasperated twitching brow.

Tight deadpan close-up reaction panel in agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean webtoon style on a pure solid #FFFFFF white background. Side by side, 오크 전사 on the left and 타우렌 드루이드 on the right stare straight ahead with completely blank, soul-drained eyes, flat mouths, heavy dark vertical gloom lines over their foreheads, and silent comic sweat drops in total speechlessness.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
아니, 왜 다들 말없이
파탈하고 귀환 타요?!
좋게 알려준 건데 억울해!
cuts.visual_prompt: Wide side-angled parting gag panel in agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean webtoon style on a pure solid #FFFFFF white background. On the left, 언데드 성기사 throws both empty hands up in bewildered outrage with her golden paladin shield strapped on her back, left all alone in the tunnel. On the right, 오크 전사 wears a flat deadpan face while cradling a smooth glowing cyan-swirl oval Hearthstone in her palm as bright turquoise teleportation ribbons spiral upward around her fading figure.
